scientific_integrity: The intact circulant rank and graph-state cut-rank identity are credited as established prior work. Finite rank enumeration supplements an arbitrary-size algebraic proof. Originality is assessed against inspected sources but not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only pure qubit graph states on C_(2n)^3 with 4|n, checkerboard cut, two omitted cross-cut controlled-Z gates at distinct even vertices; no claims for noisy gates, other partitions or arbitrary fault sets.
title: Complete two-gate entanglement trichotomy on third-power cyclic graph states
